_comment: The new-style stills in assets/src/ (DESIGN §10) and the sprite each becomes, for `npm run assets:stills`. A still whose file name is not its sprite's key is mapped here rather than renamed. `crop` trims source pixels [left, top, right, bottom] before keying, for a defect in the render itself; the file is never edited. `sprite: null` is a still with no building to stand for, kept unplaced. A still that fails the plate assertion is reported and not written, and its building keeps the sprite it had.

stills._note: clay pit is the clay works (🟡 mapped by Claude, 2026-09-27)
the market is folded into the forum (DESIGN §4.4, the seat, 2026-09-28); the forum keeps its own still
the shrine is the temple's first tier (🟡 mapped by Claude, 2026-09-27)

stills._crop: the render carries a 15×112 px black bar on its top-right edge (x 2743–2757, y 0–111); Mathias chose to crop it in the pipeline, 2026-09-27

stills._note: the praetorium anchor (DESIGN §10). No praetorium building yet, and it fails the plate assertion (slopes +0.286 / −0.294).
